title: Who Benefits From My Growth?
headline: Who Benefits When You Grow?
headline_sub: I Am Not Merely Transformed. I Am Sent.
tagline: Spiritual maturity is not measured by what you know. It is measured by what overflows.
seo_title: Who Benefits When You Grow Spiritually? A Mirror for Men | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Spiritual maturity isn't measured by what you know but by what overflows. A reflection, prayer and declaration for men on living sent.
verse_text: As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.

scriptures.text: As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.

items: Ask yourself:
If God transformed every area of my life….
who would experience the blessing?
Your family?
Your children?
Your friends?
Your coworkers?
Your brothers?
Spiritual maturity is not measured by what you know.
It is measured by what overflows.
Jesus,
Thank You for every lesson, every correction, every breakthrough, every season of growth, and every place where You have formed me.
Forgive me for making transformation the finish line.
Show me where You are calling me to invest in others.
Open my eyes to the people You’ve entrusted to me.
Help me live on mission.
Help me steward influence faithfully.
Help me become the kind of man who not only follows the Way but helps others find it.
As the Father sent You, send me.
Amen.
I am not merely transformed. I am sent.
I am not merely growing. I am multiplying.
I am not merely receiving. I am contributing.
God has entrusted people to my influence.
Jesus is the Way.
I will walk with Him.
And I will help others walk with Him too.
The goal was never a better version of you.
The goal was a surrendered version of you.
A man so transformed by Christ….
that Christ can now work through him.
